name: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
title: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd - 506405 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Sulfur-driven price pass-through held absolute margins while working capital and ~9% short-term borrowing costs rose; no numeric FY27 guidance, Roha ran ~60% for about 15 days in March.

utilisation.quote: we slowed down the plant to about 60% capacity and just to ensure that we didn't need to shut down

capex.peers_comment: Management said Kutch Copper appears not to be operating at capacity, with lower volumes of sulfuric acid available.

triggers.label: Roha utilisation cut to ~60% in March
triggers.quote: we slowed down the plant to about 60% capacity and just to ensure that we didn't need to shut down

triggers.label: Working capital up on sulfur and boron prepayments
triggers.quote: the absolute value of the stocks, debtors, everything has gone up, which is why we needed the extra working capital

triggers.label: FY27 utilisation guided only qualitatively
triggers.quote: we expect it to be better than it was in FY25-26

guidance.quote: we expect it to be better than it was in FY25-26

red_flags.label: Short-term borrowings expanding substantially
red_flags.quote: which is why you will see the short-term borrowings expanding substantially

red_flags.label: Management refuses segment or margin disclosure
red_flags.quote: We will continue to report a single segment.

red_flags.label: Land monetisation stalled, Maharashtra not transferring title
red_flags.quote: The Maharashtra government has still not transferred the land back to our name in spite of the court order.

evasions.topic: Sulfur inventory cost and purchase price
evasions.quote: I couldn't tell you exactly what is the price we bought it and what is the price now.
So, this year, again, it's too volatile to give a projection.
We will continue to report a single segment.
